<h2>About</h2>
<p>I spent four years at Tata Consultancy Services as an automation engineer, building and maintaining
Python + Selenium test suites for enterprise web applications, validating REST APIs and databases with
Postman and SQL, and running automated tests in Jenkins CI pipelines. I also hold a B.S. in Computer Science
and an M.S. in Data Science, so I'm just as comfortable digging into data with pandas, scikit-learn and
Power BI as I am chasing down a flaky test.</p>
